body: This code is used only in tests. So we could easily add mutex here.
@spolitov Which part is test-only? Should we just also rename the API to `::TEST_xxx`, to signal that?
Lowering priority, as per Sergei's note that it's test-only. Leaving in Jonathan's queue for now.
